facts.text: Hotel de Russie sits between Piazza del Popolo and the Spanish Steps in Rome.
facts.excerpt: A true Roman luminary between Piazza del Popolo and the Spanish Steps, the classical and cosmopolitan come together at Hotel de Russie.

facts.text: The hotel's address is Via del Babuino 9, Rome.
facts.excerpt: Via del Babuino 9

facts.text: The rooms were designed by Olga Polizzi.
facts.excerpt: Our rooms have been designed by Olga Polizzi, with your comfort in mind.

facts.text: Picasso stayed at the hotel for several months in 1917, and the Picasso Suite with Terrace is named for him.
facts.excerpt: Named for the celebrated artist who stayed here for several months in 1917, our Picasso Suite with Terrace pays homage to its namesake through its expressive, elegant décor.

facts.text: The Nijinsky Suite with Terrace pays tribute to ballet dancer and choreographer Vaslav Nijinsky, who was a frequent visitor to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: pays tribute to the graceful poise of esteemed ballet dancer and choreographer, Vaslav Nijinsky, who was a frequent visitor to Hotel de Russie.

facts.text: The Nijinsky Suite with Terrace has views of the garden, Villa Borghese and the Pincio.
facts.excerpt: Garden, Villa Borghese and the Pincio

facts.text: The Popolo Suite with Terrace has a wraparound terrace overlooking Piazza del Popolo.
facts.excerpt: With a stunning wraparound terrace that overlooks the historic Piazza del Popolo

facts.text: The Valadier Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows and a French balcony overlooking Pincian Hill and the hotel's Secret Garden.
facts.excerpt: The airy and bright Valadier Suite has elegant floor-to-ceiling windows and a French balcony overlooking Pincian Hill and Hotel de Russie’s Secret Garden.

facts.text: Forte Suite benefits include a return airport transfer.
facts.excerpt: Return transfer to/from airport

facts.text: Le Jardin has an outdoor terrace at the foot of the Pincio, surrounded by mature pine and flowering citrus.
facts.excerpt: to the verdant outdoor terrace at the foot of the Pincio, surrounded by mature pine and flowering citrus

facts.text: Le Jardin's Italian cuisine is overseen by Chef Fulvio Pierangelini.
facts.excerpt: Famed for its Italian cuisine, the restaurant celebrates Mediterranean flavours under the guidance of Chef Fulvio Pierangelini.

facts.text: The Stravinskij Bar is set around an intimate open-air piazzetta.
facts.excerpt: Set around an intimate open-air piazzetta, the Stravinskij Bar is a timeless retreat

facts.text: The Stravinskij Bar's 'Rome in a Sip' cocktail menu was created by Maestro Salvatore Calabrese and Mattia Capezzuoli.
facts.excerpt: Created by Maestro Salvatore Calabrese and Mattia Capezzuoli, the menu captures the spirit of Rome

facts.text: Aquazzura Bar serves tequila cocktails paired with small bites by Fulvio Pierangelini.
facts.excerpt: Tequila cocktails paired with small bites by Fulvio Pierangelini, served on Aquazzura Secret Garden tableware

facts.text: Aquazzura Bar was created by Lydia Forte and Edgardo Osorio.
facts.excerpt: that Lydia Forte and Edgardo Osorio were inspired to create Aquazzura Bar at the Hotel de Russie.

facts.text: Irene Forte Spa has a saltwater hydro pool, sauna and steam room.
facts.excerpt: A saltwater hydro pool, sauna, and steam room

facts.text: The spa has a gym with Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: A state-of-the-art gym with the latest Technogym equipment

facts.text: The spa's signature treatments use Irene Forte Skincare, with ingredients from the brand's organic farm at Verdura Resort in Sicily.
facts.excerpt: Signature treatments feature Irene Forte Skincare, with natural ingredients sourced from our organic farm at Verdura Resort in Sicily

facts.text: The Rocco Forte Kids programme is tailored for babies, kids and teens.
facts.excerpt: our programme is tailored for babies (ages 0-3), kids (ages 4-12) and teens (ages 13-16).

facts.text: The hotel's kids mascot is a baby frog that lives in the terraced Secret Garden.
facts.excerpt: Hotel de Russie’s baby frog lives in the shade of the hotel’s terraced Secret Garden.

facts.text: Baby meals are complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Baby meals are complimentary

facts.text: 24-hour babysitting is available on request, subject to a supplement.
facts.excerpt: 24-hour babysitting is available upon request and subject to supplement

facts.text: The restaurants have no dress code but ask guests to avoid sportswear, shorts and beach shoes.
facts.excerpt: whilst we do not operate a dress code, we kindly recommend that our guests are respectful of the environment we have created here at Hotel de Russie and refrain from wearing sportswear, shorts and beach shoes in our restaurants.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes Olga Polizzi's style throughout, from cream stone sculptures to pop art above the marble staircase.
facts.excerpt: Olga Polizzi, has left her impeccable style everywhere you look, from cream stone sculptures to scarlet and blue pop art hanging above the marble staircase.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler reports that the bathrooms use Carrara marble.
facts.excerpt: The bathrooms are all about Carrera marble all the way, with soft bathrobes and slippers.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says rooms and suites were refurbished for the hotel's 25th anniversary, without giving a year.
facts.excerpt: It’s Hotel de Russie’s 25th anniversary this year, and rooms and suites have been refurbished and refreshed to mark the occasion.

facts.text: Le Jardin is described as one of Rome's most exclusive restaurants.
facts.excerpt: Le Jardin is renowned as one of Rome's most exclusive restaurants.
